title: Snowsports School Session Times, Meeting Places and Grace Periods
content:
Each Snowsports School product runs from its own published start time on the mountain's clock, meets at its own place, and allows its own grace period in minutes after the scheduled start within which a late participant is still taken into the session.

| Product | Scheduled start | Meeting place | Grace period (minutes) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 10:00 | Granite Ridge base lodge school yard | 10 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 09:30 | Explorers meeting flag at the base lodge | 15 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 09:30 | Cubs Centre entrance at the base lodge | 15 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 16:00 | Development Programme tent at the race arena | 10 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 10:00 | Semi-private meeting flag at the base lodge | 10 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 09:00 | Private lesson desk in the base lodge lobby | 20 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 08:30 | Performance Centre at the Silverpine Basin gondola | 5 |

Times are stated on a 24-hour clock. The grace period is the number of minutes after the scheduled start within which a late participant is still taken into the session.

## Boundary readings of the grace periods

- The Elite Performance Camp is scheduled from 08:30 and allows 5 minutes, so its grace period runs out at 08:35.
- The Private Instruction Full Day is scheduled from 09:00 and allows 20 minutes, the longest in the range, so its grace period runs out at 09:20.
- The two children's group products are both scheduled from 09:30 and both allow 15 minutes, so their grace periods run out at 09:45.
- The Six-Week Development Programme is the only product of the range scheduled for the afternoon, from 16:00, and it allows 10 minutes, the same as the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson and the Semi-Private Coaching Session.
